description: React component implementing a data table with AG Grid, including search, sorting, filtering, pagination, and state management features for a Superset plugin.

classes.name: AgGridState
classes.description: Partial state of AG Grid, including timestamp and change indicator.

classes.name: AgGridChartStateWithMetadata
classes.description: Extended AG Grid chart state with optional metadata like timestamp and change indicator.

classes.name: AgGridTableProps
classes.description: Props interface for the AgGridDataTable React component, including configuration, data, callbacks, and state.

methods.name: onGridReady
methods.description: Initializes grid, sizes columns, and restores column state if available.

methods.name: handleSearchFocus
methods.description: Marks the search input as focused.

methods.name: handleSearchBlur
methods.description: Marks the search input as blurred.

methods.name: onFilterTextBoxChanged
methods.description: Handles search input changes, updating state and triggering debounce search.

methods.name: handleColSort
methods.description: Handles column sorting logic, applies column state, and triggers onSortChange callback.

methods.name: handleColumnHeaderClick
methods.description: Handles clicks on column headers to trigger sorting.

methods.name: handleGridStateChange
methods.description: Debounced function to capture and save grid state (column order, sort, filters).

methods.name: handleFilterChanged
methods.description: Handles filter changes, validates, and updates filter state via callback.
